name: Homebase
summary: Homebase is priced per location, not per user: a free Basic plan for up to 10 employees, then $30 (Essentials), $70 (Plus) and $120 (All-in-One) a month for unlimited employees. The pricing page does not say whether those figures are monthly or annual rates. Payroll is a separate add-on.

facts.text: The free Basic plan covers up to 10 employees at one location, and a 14-day trial of All-in-One needs no credit card.
Payroll is an add-on at a $49 monthly base fee plus $6 a month per employee paid, with the first 6 months free.
Homebase says data is encrypted with AES-256 at rest and TLS in transit, and lists single sign-on, two-factor authentication and role-based access control.
The security page names no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 report and does not state where data is hosted.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Up to 10 employees at one location

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Unlimited employees. The page has an Annual and Monthly toggle with a 20% saving badge and does not label which period this price reflects

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Page also shows $0 beside a six-month free payroll offer; we read $70 as the plan price. Period not labeled

plans.name: All-in-One
plans.notes: Adds onboarding, labor cost management and HR and compliance. Period not labeled

hiddenCosts: Payroll costs $49 a month plus $6 per employee paid after a free first 6 months.
Tip Manager is $25 a month per location and Task Manager is $13 a month per location.
